response.sql: WITH channel_avgs AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) as bench_value FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ca.avg_feerate, (ca.avg_feerate - b.bench_value) as excess FROM channel_avgs ca, benchmark b WHERE ca.avg_feerate > b.bench_value) SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_of_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_of_excesses FROM above_benchmark
